debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-m-i-t-t-e-d c-o-v-e-r b-i-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s a-t-t-a-c-h-e-d t-o t-h-e t-e-n-d-e-r f-i-l-e and l-e-f-t s-t-a-m-p-e-d i-n-v-i-t-e s b-e-h-i-n-d w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t d-e-c-l-a-r-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
2) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d s-h-a-r-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g w-o-r-k-s-h-e-e-t-s a-m-o-n-g the t-h-r-e-e p-a-r-t-i-c-i-p-a-n-t-s and l-e-f-t v-e-r-s-i-o-n e-d-i-t l-o-g-s a-s a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e p-l-a-i-n-b-a-c-k e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e r-e-v-i-e-w
3) the a-c-t-o-r s-e-t t-h-e r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e for w-i-n-n-i-n-g r-o-u-n-d-s a-c-r-o-s-s the s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e-d r-o-u-n-d-s and l-e-f-t d-a-t-e-m-a-r-k-e-d c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r e-n-t-r-y-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-a-n-d-o-m-i-z-a-t-i-o-n c-o-n-t-r-o-l
4) the a-c-t-o-r a-r-r-a-n-g-e-d h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s t-h-r-o-u-g-h s-i-b-i-l-l-i-n-g a-d-j-u-s-t-m-e-n-t-s and l-e-f-t r-e-i-n-v-o-i-c-e-d i-t-e-m i-s-s-u-e s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e b-e-n-c-h-m-a-r-k m-a-r-k-u-p a-u-d-i-t
5) the a-c-t-o-r l-e-v-e-r-a-g-e-d p-u-b-l-i-c n-o-t-i-c-e s to m-i-m-i-c c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-o-n in the p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t t-r-a-c-e and l-e-f-t p-h-o-t-o-c-o-p-i-e-d a-w-a-r-d n-o-t-e-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
